cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-15: the Morocco Accelerator at Technopark Casablanca closed a 19-startup cohort in July 2026 (MAR-003), Agadir Technopark runs three programmes for startups (MAR-004), and the Essaouira technopark is home to startups and SMEs (MAR-007), so every rung is met: 2 to 5.
